verdict.rationale: LlamaParse's marketing page claims it turns handwriting and checkboxes into clean markdown. The enriched forms pass returns form fields with values, checkbox states and bounding boxes. Nothing in the pack shows confidence scores or flags for uncertain handwritten text, and the handwriting claim rests on a single marketing line. missing for 10: per-field confidence scores or uncertainty flagging, in-depth docs on handwriting recognition and annotation extraction, independent or hands-on corroboration of handwriting accuracy
